title: Count Mentions Per User
summary: Given the total number of users and an array of events, including message and offline events, calculate the total number of mentions each user receives in message events.
statement: Given the total number of users and an array of events, including message and offline events, calculate the total number of mentions each user receives in message events. Users start online, and their status changes are processed before handling any message event that occurs at the same timestamp. Mentions can include individual user IDs, 'ALL', and 'HERE', with duplicates counted. Offline users are still included in the mentions count.
constraints: There are 1–100 users, all initially online; events contain a type, integer timestamp string, and payload.
OFFLINE makes one online user unavailable for 60 time units and is processed before messages at the same timestamp.
ALL mentions every user, HERE mentions users online then, and explicit id tokens count even offline and count duplicates.
hints: Offline expiration timestamps avoid scheduling separate online events.
Sort chronologically with OFFLINE before MESSAGE, and handle the three mention forms separately.
Update one expiration for OFFLINE; count HERE from expirations, explicit tokens directly, and defer universal ALL additions.
Each event is evaluated against exactly the status required at its timestamp, while deferred ALL counts apply equally to every user.
editorial: Each event is evaluated against exactly the status required at its timestamp, while deferred ALL counts apply equally to every user.

tests.explanation: The explicit message mentions both users, and both are online again for HERE at time 71, yielding [2,2].
The offline event precedes HERE, so only user one receives it; explicit id0 still counts, yielding [1,1].
